changes: Guild bounty officers now follow your guild's rank permissions: ranks with officer permissions approve submissions, and their own submissions reach the guild at once.
The bounty board shows players from your realm without the realm name. Other realms are marked (*); hover the row or open the bounty to see the realm.
notice: /reload is enough after updating Highground, Bounties or Nearby; this release adds no files. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
